python.setup:
control = fluentqt.PropertyPanel(%PARENT%)
title_def = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition()
title_def.key = "title"
title_def.label = "Title"
title_def.group = "General"
title_def.defaultValue = "Quarterly report"
visible_def = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition()
visible_def.key = "visible"
visible_def.label = "Visible"
visible_def.group = "General"
visible_def.type = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition.Type.Boolean
visible_def.defaultValue = True
density_def = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition()
density_def.key = "density"
density_def.label = "Density"
density_def.group = "Layout"
density_def.type = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition.Type.Choice
density_def.choices = ["Compact", "Standard", "Comfortable"]
density_def.defaultValue = "Standard"
spacing_def = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition()
spacing_def.key = "spacing"
spacing_def.label = "Spacing"
spacing_def.group = "Layout"
spacing_def.type = fluentqt.PropertyDefinition.Type.Number
spacing_def.minimum = 0
spacing_def.maximum = 32
spacing_def.step = 4
spacing_def.defaultValue = 12
control.setProperties([title_def, visible_def, density_def, spacing_def])
